sequence_points.name: Stormy Landscape with Dark Sky
sequence_points.description: A dramatic landscape painting featuring a turbulent, dark sky with swirling clouds above a silhouetted terrain of trees and hills. The composition uses deep blues and blacks to convey a moody, atmospheric scene, mounted on a museum wall.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Vertical Forms
sequence_points.description: A monochromatic abstract painting featuring vertical and horizontal strokes, with a central dark form resembling a tower or structure. The artwork is mounted on a wall, framed by a simple border, and appears to be part of a gallery exhibit.

sequence_points.name: Mountain Landscape with Reflection
sequence_points.description: A framed painting depicting a mountainous landscape with snow-capped peaks reflected in a calm lake below, surrounded by evergreen trees. The scene is rendered in cool tones of blue, white, and green, mounted on a gray wall above other artworks.

sequence_points.name: Mountain Climber in Snowy Landscape
sequence_points.description: A photograph depicting a lone climber ascending a snow-covered mountain peak, surrounded by dramatic clouds and rugged terrain. The image is mounted on a wall with a dark border, emphasizing the contrast between the bright snow and the deep blue sky.
